title: Crispy Pork Tacos
description: A Mexican-inspired dish featuring crispy pork, crunchy slaw, and tangy salsa.
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together lime juice, cumin, chili powder, and salt.
Rub the spice mixture all over the pork shoulder, making sure to coat it evenly.
Heat the olive oil in a large oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the pork shoulder for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until browned.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the pork is cooked through.
While the pork is cooking, prepare the slaw by combining shredded cabbage, diced red onion, and crushed tortilla chips in a bowl.
Once the pork is done, let it rest for 5 minutes before slicing it thinly against the grain.
Serve the sliced pork in tacos with the slaw, salsa, and any other desired toppings.
